releases.body:
### Equal-height project cards

* Every project card now receives the tallest card's height as well as one
  computed width, so a card on a shorter row (PerunChat alone) is the same size
  as the first-row cards. Actions are pinned to the card bottom; the height is
  recomputed on render, resize and presence updates.

### Project card size restored

* The grid uses the maximum column count again (restoring the previous
  first-row card size), keeps one computed width for every card, and a partly
  filled last row starts at the first column instead of being rebalanced or
  centered.

### Project grid row balancing

* The grid now chooses a column count that avoids a single card alone on the
  last row (6 cards at a wide width become 4+2 instead of 5+1), caps cards at
  520px, and keeps every card at one width; a partial last row is centered.

### Project grid balance

* Every project card now uses the same computed width for the current column
  count; a partly filled last row is centered instead of stretching the final
  card across the row (PerunChat alone no longer becomes full-width).

### Project grid shares a partial last row

* The Projects grid now uses flex-wrap with growable cards, so a partly filled
  last row (for example PerunChat alone at two columns) fills the width instead
  of squeezing the last card into one grid column. Long names and descriptions
  wrap instead of forcing a wider track.

### Documentation refresh

* README, DESIGN, and the retrievable context docs now describe TUI session
  resume/selection, the console-handle Focus path, the shared-project **Pause
  work** control, coroutine task composition, and the release-notes/changelog
  placement rule.

### Shared header separates chat and work state

* The Shared tab header now labels the room binding separately (**Chat active**
  / **Chat pending sync**) and shows a dedicated **Work paused** / **Work
  running** badge, so a paused project no longer looks active.

### Hardening for the work pause and TUI launch

* A TUI launch only finishes/untracks its run on a **definitive** server error;
  a network-uncertain failure leaves the run stopable because the terminal may
  have opened.
* Paused projects annotate peer-review requests for pending proposals so peers
  hold the review; activity logging is best effort and the project-card `paused`
  badge refreshes immediately after a toggle. A transient binding-read failure
  keeps a recently paused room paused for a grace period instead of silently
  resuming autonomy.
* Scheduled/time-based coroutines keep their own Pause control; the project flag
  suppresses room-driven autonomy only (replies, room events, review, policy
  auto-approve).

### Operator mentions survive a work pause

* A room message naming the operator still creates an attention item while the
  project's autonomous work is paused; a notification is not agent work, and the
  operator needs the ask to decide whether to resume.

### Pause autonomous work in a shared project

* The Shared tab has **Pause work** / **Resume work** (durable
  `projects.work_paused`, with the actor and timestamp); the project card is
  badged `paused`. While paused the bridge posts no room replies, does not feed
  the room's messages to coroutine triggers, skips the autonomous proposal
  review, and policy auto-approve leaves new proposals pending. In-flight runs
  finish; human chat and explicit approvals remain available.
* Members can keep chatting: paused messages stay in room history for the agent
  to catch up after a resume. The bridge posts one notice per pause period so the
  room knows why the agent is silent.
